hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; case "$f" in *.ts|*.tsx) npx prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" && npx oxlint --deny-warnings "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; *.css|*.json|*.html) npx prettier --write --log-level warn "$f" >&2 || exit 2 ;; esac
